Overview.Name: Kanaka Maha Lakshmi
Overview.Goal: Preventing/reversing health issues, Achieve healthy weight loss, Improve strength and recovery from gym workouts.

Early_Morning (optional): Option 3: Any 1 fruit (apple, guava, orange or papaya)
Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer cubes (100 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 2: Thick curd (200 g) + avocado (1/2 medium)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small bowl ~150 g) + curd (small bowl)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + paneer curry (120 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + soya chunks curry (80 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + mixed vegetable curry + curd (small bowl)
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + paneer cubes (100 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + soya chunks curry (80 g) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + curd (200 g) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Aim to sleep for at least 7 hours whenever possible to support recovery and weight loss.
Continue your regular gym workouts and include protein-rich foods in every main meal.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Stay well hydrated by drinking at least 2.5–3 litres of water every day.
Include plenty of vegetables with lunch and dinner for better nutrition and fullness.
Maintain consistent meal timings to support your fitness and health goals.
